decision: Remove the legacy test database name and direct references from backend test configuration, while preserving the real productdb database and all production connection settings.
rationale: Integration tests must never silently fall back to a production database. CI and local dotenv configuration now identify a dedicated test database, TEST_DATABASE_URL is mandatory, and the production-only reset verification is not run by the generic CI integration job.
validation: The shared test-database configuration rejects an unset URL, a missing database name, and a URL targeting the production database. The orphaned seed utility was confirmed unreferenced before removal.
sensitive_data: No production database operation, container operation, migration change, or credential change is part of this decision.
